gloss: sure hit; certain to hit the mark

definitions.gloss: sure hit; hitting without fail; certain to strike the target
definitions.explanation: Hitting a target with certainty. Used in archery, martial arts, military contexts, and figuratively for plans or strategies that are bound to succeed.

examples.japanese: {百発百中|ひゃっぱつひゃくちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{必中|ひっちゅう}⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{誇|ほこ}る→誇る：14180_hokoru⟧。
⟦{弓道|きゅうどう}→弓道：04453_kyuudou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{必中|ひっちゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}して→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧⟦{日々|ひび}→日々：04804_hibi⟧⟦{稽古|けいこ}→稽古：00210_keiko⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: In kyudo, one practices daily aiming for a sure hit.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}てた→立てる：01196_tateru⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{必中|ひっちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{策|さく}→策：09997_saku⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われていた→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{思|おも}わぬ→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦{障害|しょうがい}→障害：03228_shougai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{阻|はば}まれた→阻む：14529_habamu⟧。
examples.english: The plan he devised was said to be a surefire strategy, but it was blocked by an unexpected obstacle.

notes:
Composed of {必|ひつ} (certain, inevitable) and ⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧ (hit the mark). The character ⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧ here uses its less common reading meaning "to hit" (as in ⟦{的中|てきちゅう}→的中：15262_tekichuu⟧, hitting the mark).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {必中|ひっちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{策|さく}→策：09997_saku⟧: surefire plan/strategy
- {必中|ひっちゅう}⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧: hit rate; accuracy rate
- {必中|ひっちゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{期|き}す: to aim for a sure hit

USAGE:
Common in martial arts (especially archery and ⟦{弓道|きゅうどう}→弓道：04453_kyuudou⟧), military/strategy contexts, and gaming. Also used figuratively in business for foolproof plans.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{的中|てきちゅう}→的中：15262_tekichuu⟧: hitting the mark; coming true — emphasizes accuracy rather than certainty
- ⟦{命中|めいちゅう}→命中：18487_meichuu⟧: direct hit — focuses on the result of actually hitting
